sloka: ग्रामान् विकृष्ट सीमान् तान् पुष्पितानि वनानि च ।पश्यन्न् अतिययौ शीघ्रम् शरैः इव हय उत्तमैः ॥२-४९-३॥
transliteration: grāmān vikṛṣṭa sīmān tān puṣpitāni vanāni ca ।paśyann atiyayau śīghram śaraiḥ iva haya uttamaiḥ ॥2-49-3॥

translations.english: Watching the villages furrowed at the outskirts, forests in blossom, hearing the gossips of the people living in the midst of villages, Rama felt he was moving very slowly whereas he had actually covered a long distance with those excellent (swift) horses.
